triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 62 (woven apparel) composition gated its reciprocal-annex, §301, §232, §201 and §338 branches on equality with five exemplar reporting numbers from chapters 22, 72, 76, 85 and 95, conditions with no basis in chapter 62's own lines or in the membership lists the module cites.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 60 (identical removed blocks; diff differs only in chapter number and the serialization-variance wording of the summary). Read the diff in full; no downstream formula changed.
triage.verifier_justification: The pre-fix chapter 62 (woven apparel) composition defined five derived Judgment rules whose formulas tested `hts_number` equality against statistical reporting numbers from chapters 72, 76, 95, 22 and 85, with proof atoms citing those other chapters' provisions (ferroalloy carbon content, aluminum coils, footballs, beer in glass, PV cells), and those flags gated ch62's reciprocal-annex exclusion (`entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded: entry_is_line_a`), §232 aluminum, §301 China, §201 solar and §338 alcohol branches — conditions with no basis in chapter 62's own lines, i.e. formulas grounded on the wrong provision, which is untraceable_branch. The change is not provenance-only: it deletes five rule formulas and moves the identifiers to caller inputs, and the companion test diff confirms the module's surface changed (five `#entry_is_line_*` outputs removed, five `#input.entry_is_line_*` added, and the old positive-coverage case that fed a chapter 62 module `hts_number: 7202.11.10.00` to make its reciprocal exclusion hold was deleted). The "never claimed" defense fails because the module computes the chapter 62 statutory stack over its own rate table while its own companion test asserted an impossible chapter-62 state, and the PR describes the pre-state coupling as having "unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins". Confidence is held at 0.7 rather than higher because this commit only strips the ungrounded derivations; the branch identifiers and their wiring are byte-identical here, so the membership-semantic re-grounding the quoted PR sentence promises is completed outside this file.
triage.verifier_notes: Verified read-only from the bundle diff (061.diff), `git show` of parent 956a5474 and 2a6bdb01de, and the ch62 companion-test diff. Caveats for the reviewer: (1) this is a bulk generator commit (tools/generate_schedule_compositions.py + 100 chapters, identical pattern), the commit message is a single generic line, and the module summary still asserts "This deterministic RuleSpec serialization changes no formula tokens, dates, inputs, proof atoms, or runtime values" — a boilerplate sentence that the input/output surface change contradicts; (2) the consuming formulas are unchanged, so at this commit ch62 still reads `if entry_is_line_a and origin_is_china: list_1_additional_ad_valorem_rate` and the §122/membership re-gating described in the PR body is not visible in this file's diff; (3) the module header's corpus_citation_paths were NOT regenerated — ch62 still cites us/statute/hts/7202.11.10.00, 7601.10.30.00, 9506.62.40(.40), 2203.00.00(.30), 8541.42.00(.10) after the rules citing them were removed (leftover provenance, worth a separate note); (4) no later commit reachable from the checkout's HEAD touches this file. If the corpus is scored per-commit and a reviewer wants the "membership-semantic" half, the sibling commits of PR #1300 carry it; this commit's contribution is the removal of the ungrounded exemplar grounding, which is the untraceable_branch half.
